name: sparx — Tattoo (Fine Line)
tagline: A bright, editorial template for fine-line tattoo studios — book online from day one.
description: A bright, minimal fine-line tattoo-studio site — a bone off-white palette, a warm near-black ink and one quiet soft-gold accent, with a clean grotesque and gallery-style work carrying the page. Installs a working booking flow: a free consultation, fine-line pieces priced by size, plus lettering and delicate floral; three artists you book by name with their own hours; and a session-deposit policy. Ships as "Faint", a light, considered studio — the calm opposite of the dark tattoo shop.
